						v10g.travelAndWait = function(pfg, pfh, pfi)
							local v1eb = pfi or {}
							if pfg.destroyed then
								return false
							end
							if pfg.travelBusy then
								if os.clock() < (pfg.travelBusyUntil or 0) then
									return false
								end
							end
							local v1ec, v1ed = pfg.activeTween and not pfg.running
							if v1ec then
								local v1ee = pfg.activeTween.sharedTravel
								v1ed = if v1ee then v1eb.preempt == true else not v1ee
							else
								v1ed = v1ec
							end
							if v1ed then
								pcall(pfg.activeTween.Cancel, pfg.activeTween)
								v1ec = os.clock() + 0.5
								while pfg.activeTween and os.clock() < v1ec do
									task.wait(0.05)
								end
							end
							if pfg.activeTween then
								return false
							end
							v1ec = vyk.Character
							local v1ef = v1ec and (v1ec:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
							if not v1ef then
								return false
							end
							pfg.travelBusy = true
							pfg.travelBusyUntil = os.clock() + 45
							v1ed, v1ec = pcall(function()
								local v1eg
								local v1eh, v1ei = os.clock(), (pfh.Position - v1ef.Position).Magnitude
								local v1ej = v1eh + v1ei / math.max(tonumber(v1eb.speed) or pfg.config.speed or 600, vz2) + 6
								pfg.travelBusyUntil = v1ej + 2

						v10g._leftTreadmill = function(pin, pio)

						v10g._reconcileRunningState = function(pip)

								pip._instantReturnToken = nil

									pip:_recallHidden()

										end
									end
								end
							end
						end) and v2ir.controls or nil
					end

							end
						end
						v2ir.finishMove = nil
						v2ir.finishInput = nil
					end
					v2ir.rivalGap = function(prb)
						local v2k7 = v2ir.path

						else
							return nil

																end
															end
														end
													end
												end
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end)

						end
						v2k9, v2ka = false

								if v2kk then
									if type(v2kl) == "number" then

										if v2ki > 5 then
											v2k9 = true
										else
											if v2ki < 0 then
												local v2km = -v2ki
												v2ka = if v2ka then if v2km < v2ka then v2km else v2ka else v2km
											else
											end
										end
									else
									end
								else
								end
							else
							end
						end
						if v2k9 then
							return 0
						end
						return v2ka
					end
					v2ir.decideSpeed = function()
						local v2kn, v2ko, v2kp =
							tonumber(state7[4]:GetAttribute("RacePlace")) or 1, v2ir.rivalGap(v2ir.legitProg), os.clock()

								v2ir.leadDone = true

					end

							v2kt.CFrame.LookVector, v2kt.CFrame.UpVector, v2ku.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude, v2ks.Length

									then math.clamp(-v2ks * 2.2, -1, 1)

								else

							else

						v2ir.legitSteer = (v2ir.legitSteer or 0) + (v2l9 - (v2ir.legitSteer or 0)) * 0.35
						v2l9 = v2ir.legitSteer
						v2ir.finishInput = Vector3.new(v2l9, 0, v2l8)

						if prc and type(prc.Jump) == "function" then

						v2kq[1] = v2ir

							string.format(

								tostring(state7[4]:GetAttribute("RacePlace") or "?")
							)

						v2kq[1].status = v2kq[2]
					end
					v2ir.findJumps = function()
						v2ir.jumpProgs = {}

					v2ir.findMount = function()
						local v2m6 = v2ir.mount

					v2ir.hazards = function()
						local v2mg = os.clock()
						if v2ir.hazardCache then
							if v2mg - v2ir.hazardAt < 0.2 then
								return v2ir.hazardCache
							end

					v2ir.step = function(prd, pre)
						local v2mt = {}
						local v2mu, v2mv = v2iz(), prd.Rig and prd.Rig.Root
						if v2mu then
							if v2ir.path then
								if not v2mv then
									return
								end
							else
								return
							end
						else
							return
						end
						if prd:IsHeld() then
							v2ir.dist = nil
							return
						end
						local v2mw, v2mx =
							v2ir.path, v2mu.Flags and v2mu.Flags.TopSpeed and v2mu.Flags.TopSpeed:Get() or 135
						if not v2ir.dist then
							local v2my, v2mz = pcall(v2mw.Project, v2mw, v2mv.Position, 0, v2mw.Length, v2mw.Length)
							v2ir.dist = v2my and type(v2mz) == "number" and v2mz or 0
							v2ir.speed = math.max(tonumber(prd.Speed) or 0, v2mx * 0.5)
						end
						if (v2mw:FrameAt(v2ir.dist).Position - v2mv.Position).Magnitude > 45 then
							local v2n0, v2n1 = pcall(v2mw.Project, v2mw, v2mv.Position, v2ir.dist, 80, 220)
							if v2n0 then
								if type(v2n1) == "number" then
									v2ir.dist = v2n1
								end
							end
						end
						v2mu = v2ir.scale or 1
						v2ir.speed = v2ir.speed + (v2mx * v2mu - v2ir.speed) * math.min(1, pre * 1.5)
						v2ir.dist = v2ir.dist + v2ir.speed * pre
						v2mu, v2mx = v2mw:FrameAt(v2ir.dist), v2mw:FrameAt(v2ir.dist + 20)
						local v2n2 = v2mu.UpVector
						local v2n3 = v2mu.RightVector
						v2n3 = if v2n3.Magnitude < 0.001 then v2mu.LookVector:Cross(v2n2) else v2n3
						local v2n4, v2n5 = v2mw:FrameAt(v2ir.dist + math.clamp(v2ir.speed * 0.6, 60, 200)).Position
							+ v2n2 * 2.5
						for v2n6, v2n7 in ipairs(v2ir.hazards()) do
							v2mw = v2n7.pos - v2n4
							local v2n8, v2n9 = math.abs(v2mw:Dot((v2mx.Position - v2mu.Position).Unit)), v2mw:Dot(v2n3)
							v2n5 = if v2n8 < v2n7.radius + 30
								then if math.abs(v2n9) < v2n7.radius + 10
									then if v2n5 then if math.abs(v2n9) < math.abs(v2n5) then v2n9 else v2n5 else v2n9
									else v2n5
								else v2n5
						end
						v2mw = if v2n5 then v2n5 > 0 and -v2ir.DODGE_STUDS or v2ir.DODGE_STUDS else 0
						v2ir.lateral = (v2ir.lateral or 0) + (v2mw - (v2ir.lateral or 0)) * math.min(1, pre * 3)
						pre = 2.5
						v2mw = state7[4].Character
						v2n4 = v2mw and (v2mw:FindFirstChild("RaceMount"))
						v2mw = v2n4 and v2n4:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
							or prd.Rig and prd.Rig.Mount and prd.Rig.Mount:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
						local function v2na(prf)
							if not v2ir.roadParams then
								local v2nb, v2nc = state7[7]:FindFirstChild("RaceTrack"), RaycastParams.new()
								v2nc.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
								v2nc.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v2nb and v2nb:FindFirstChild("Track") }
								v2ir.roadParams = v2nc
							end
							local v2nd = state7[7]:Raycast(prf + v2n2 * 60, -v2n2 * 120, v2ir.roadParams)
							return v2nd and v2nd.Position or nil
						end
						local v2ne, v2nf =
							v2na(v2mu.Position + v2n3 * v2ir.lateral),
							v2mw and (v2mw.Position - v2mv.Position):Dot(v2n2) or 0
						v2n4 = (v2mw and v2mw.Size.Y / 2 or 2) + 0.3 - v2nf
						v2nf, v2mw =
							v2ne and v2ne + v2n2 * v2n4 or v2mu.Position + v2n2 * pre + v2n3 * v2ir.lateral,
							v2na(v2mx.Position + v2n3 * v2ir.lateral)
						v2na = (v2mw and v2mw + v2n2 * v2n4 or v2mx.Position + v2n2 * pre + v2n3 * v2ir.lateral) - v2nf
						v2n4 = v2na.Magnitude > 0.001 and v2na.Unit or v2mu.LookVector
						v2mv.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v2n4 * v2ir.speed + (v2nf - v2mv.Position) * 9
						v2mv.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
						prd.Drive.Enabled = false
						v2mt[1] = prd.Push
						v2mt[2] = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * v2mv.AssemblyMass * state7[7].Gravity
						v2mt[1].Force = v2mt[2]
						prd.Align.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), v2n4, v2n2)
						v2mv.CFrame = CFrame.new(v2mv.Position) * prd.Align.CFrame
						prd.Up = v2n2
						prd.Heading = v2n4
						prd.TravelDirection = v2n4
						prd.Speed = v2ir.speed
						prd.Grounded = v2ne ~= nil
						prd.AirSeconds = 0
						prd.Launched = v2ne == nil
					end
					v2ir.override = function(prg, prh)
						if not (pcall(v2ir.step, prg, prh)) then
							prg.Override = nil
							v2ir.dist = nil
						end
					end
					v2ir.drive = function(pri)
						if v2ir.active then
							return
						end
						v2ir.active = true
						v2ir.dist = nil
						v2ir.mount = nil
						v2ir.stuns = 0

					v2qk.tradeUp = function()
						v2qk.snapshot()
						if not (v2qk.canTrade()) then
							return false, "nothing to trade up"
						end
						local v2ue, v2uf = v2tr("ButterflyMachine")
						if not v2ue then
							return false, v2uf
						end
						local v2ug, v2uh, v2ui, v2uj = v2qk.tiers(), vlg.ButterflyTradeRecipe, 0
						if v2uh == "Smart" then
							v2ue = table.clone(v2qk.snap.counts)
							v2uj = v2ui
							while v2uj < 50 do
								v2uf = v2qk.smartNext(v2ue)
								if not v2uf then
									break
								end
								v2qk.status = "Trading up " .. v2ug[v2uf].name .. " for the essence"
								local v2uk, v2ul = v2r5("Butterflies", "AskTradeUp", v2uf)
								if not v2uk then
									if v2uj == 0 then
										return false, v2ul or "the machine refused"
									end
									break
								end
								v2uj += 1
								v2ue[v2uf] = (v2ue[v2uf] or 0) - v2ug[v2uf].trade
								v2ul = v2ql[v2qm[v2uf] + 1]
								v2ue[v2ul] = (v2ue[v2ul] or 0) + 1
								task.wait(0.12)
							end
							return true, v2uj
						end
						v2uj = v2ui
						for v2um = 3, 1, -1 do
							v2ue = v2ql[v2um]
							if v2uh == nil or v2uh == "All" or v2uh == v2ue then
								v2ui, v2um = v2qk.snap.counts[v2ue] or 0, v2ug[v2ue].trade
								while v2um > 0 and v2ui >= v2um do
									v2qk.status = "Trading up " .. v2ug[v2ue].name
									local v2un, v2uo = v2r5("Butterflies", "AskTradeUp", v2ue)
									if not v2un then
										if v2uj == 0 then
											return false, v2uo or "the machine refused"
										end
										break
									end
									v2uj += 1
									v2ui -= v2um
									task.wait(0.12)
								end
							else
							end
						end
						return true, v2uj
					end

					v2qk.fuseForest = function(psh)
						local v2vi = v2qv()

									{ area = "Enchanted Forest" },
									("Hunting Enchanted Forest eggs  \194\183  %d / %d"):format(

					v2y5.moveStep = function(pt3, pt4, pt5, pt6, pt7, pt8, pt9)

						pt3 = v2yy.Magnitude <= v2yz and pt6 or v2yx + v2yy.Unit * v2yz
						v2yz = (pt7 or pt6) - pt3
						pt6 = Vector3.new(v2yz.X, 0, v2yz.Z)

						vhn(pt3)

					v3dz._tryEnterArena = function(pxi, pxj)

							local v3ht = CFrame.lookAt(v3hs, v3hq.Position)

								return pxi:_inArena()

									v3hr = true

									pxi.enterCooldownUntil = os.clock() + 3.5

								end

					v3dz._stepFight = function(py2, py3)
						py2:_beginArena(py3)
						local v3j9 = tostring(py3:GetAttribute("Phase") or "Waiting")
						py2.lastPhase = v3j9
						if v3du:GetAttribute("ScrambleGrabbed") == true then
							local v3ja = os.clock()
							if v3ja - py2.lastGrabEscapeAt >= 0.08 then
								py2.lastGrabEscapeAt = v3ja
								pcall(function()
									if v3dy then
										if v3dy.HazardHit then
											v3dy.HazardHit:FireServer(-2)
										end
									end
								end)
							end
							py2:_setStatus("Grabbed - breaking free")
							return
						end
						if v3j9 == "Waiting" then
							local v3jb =
								math.max(0, (tonumber(py3:GetAttribute("SpawnsAt")) or 0) - workspace2:GetServerTimeNow())
							py2:_setStatus(
								v3jb > 0 and string.format("Boss starts in %ds", math.ceil(v3jb)) or "Waiting for challengers"
							)
						elseif v3j9 == "Mech" then
							py2:_fightMech(py3)
						elseif v3j9 == "Ejecting" then
							py2:_stopMovement()
							py2:_setStatus("Mech defeated - ejecting")
						elseif v3j9 == "Ball" then
							py2:_fightBall(py3)
						elseif v3j9 == "Human" then
							py2:_fightHuman(py3)
						elseif v3j9 == "Final" then

								return string.format("in %dm", math.floor(selector10 / 60))
							end
							return string.format("in %.1fh", selector10 / 3600)
						end

							return "Just now"
						end
						if v3sr < 3600 then
							return string.format("%dm ago", math.floor(v3sr / 60))
						end
						if v3sr < 86400 then
							return string.format("%.1fh ago", v3sr / 3600)
						end

					end

			return 24, offset68 + 4, v5e9, p1is
		end
	end,
